sources.title: Government of the Commonwealth of Dominica, How Do I Apply for a Passport?
sources.said: Passport Application Fees - to be paid at the Treasury Department ... Children under 16 years of age: EC$75.00 Adults (16 years or older): EC$150.00 ... The normal processing time for passports is two (2) weeks. In an emergency, for example, in the case of illness, passports can be processed almost immediately, or within two to three working days.
